contexts.text: When... the systolic motions of the heart cease...
The systolic motion of the heart (is one of the) bonds, which, being broken, the spirit is left to itself...
Like the motion of the heart, which is called systole and diastole. DP 319, Defined.
As the motions of the heart, which are called systole and diastole, change and vary according to the affections of each man's love...
The celestial things of the Word are like the systole and diastole of the heart.
3. 2. Hence there is in man both an internal and an external systolic and animatory motion; an external one which is natural, and an internal one which is spiritual.
